svg.title: Instituto Salvador Moncada Records - Project Specification Diagram
svg.desc: A proposed full-stack school records application showing users, frontend, authentication, API, database, user stories, acceptance criteria, and implementation priorities.
svg.text: Instituto Salvador Moncada Records
Proposed full-stack application | Specification diagram | P1 = minimum viable product
PURPOSE AND USERS
Administrators, teachers, and staff replace fragmented paper records with secure, centralized student and academic data.
P1 | FRONTEND: RESPONSIVE NEXT.JS APPLICATION
Views: Sign up / sign in and profile • Student records • Courses and enrollments • Grades and academic history
Shared components: navigation, form fields, data tables, search/filter, and feedback messages.
P1 | ACCOUNT ACCESS, SECURITY, AND VALIDATION
Auth.js or Clerk; server-side authorization and validation; deny unauthorized requests and reject invalid input.
Proposed roles: administrators manage users and records; teachers and staff access records according to assigned permissions.
P1 | BACKEND: PROPOSED REST API
/api/students and /api/students/:id — create, list, read, update, and delete student profiles
/api/courses and /api/courses/:id — create, list, read, update, and delete courses
/api/enrollments and /api/enrollments/:id — create, list, read, update, and delete enrollments
/api/grades and /api/grades/:id — create, list, read, update, and delete grades
P1 | DATABASE AND DATA RELATIONSHIPS
Students + Courses → Enrollments → Grades | PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Supabase: team to decide
P1 | USER STORIES AND ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
Account: A user can sign up and sign in with valid information; invalid information displays an error.
Students: An authorized user can create, read, update, and delete profiles; invalid data is rejected.
Courses and enrollments: Authorized users can manage both; duplicate enrollments are rejected.
Grades: Authorized users can manage grades; invalid grades and unauthorized changes are rejected.
Academic history: An authorized user can view the selected student's enrollments and grades.
All actions provide appropriate loading, success, and error feedback.
TECHNOLOGY AND DEPLOYMENT
Next.js App Router • TypeScript • Tailwind CSS
Server and client rendering • Render hosting proposed
P2 | FUTURE ENHANCEMENT
Expanded academic reports
Planning diagram; proposed roles, database, and hosting require team confirmation.
